# Grill LED Accent Lighting

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Determine best location, wire LEDs in parallel with red and black wires together, then tap into existing parking lights. [t1034]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. Determine the best location for LEDs, such as above the front emblem or along the bottom of a license plate holder.
2. Wire the new LED lights in parallel by connecting all positive (red) wires together and all negative (black/ground) wires together.

_Procedure reported by [t1034]._

## Parts

- [Partial] Amber or white LEDs [t1034]
- [Partial] Wiring harness, 2-wire per light [t1034]

## Tips & gotchas

- Tap the new LED circuit directly into the existing parking lights so they illuminate simultaneously. [t1034]
- Consider installing a bumper first to ensure final LED placement is visible. [t1034]
